content: She's unlike anybody he's ever met. From M. Night Shyamalan, #RemainMovie is in theaters Valentine's Day 2027. From Warner Bros. Pictures, Remain, starring Jake Gyllenhaal, is an unprecedented collaboration between two of the world’s most creative minds: best-selling author Nicholas Sparks, and visionary filmmaker M. Night Shyamalan. When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town. Gyllenhaal stars alongside Phoebe Dynevor, Ashley Walters, Julie Hagerty and Jay O. Sanders. Shyamalan directs from his own screenplay, story by Shyamalan and Sparks. The film is produced by Shyamalan, Ashwin Rajan, Marc Bienstock and Theresa Park, with Sparks executive producing. Joining Shyamalan behind the camera are director of photography Adolpho Veloso, production designer Sam Lisenco, editor Noëmi Preiswerk, costume designer Caroline Duncan, casting director Douglas Aibel, music supervisor Gabe Hilfer and composer James Newton Howard. Warner Bros. Pictures Presents a Blinding Edge Pictures Production, an M. Night Shyamalan Film, Remain, in theaters across North America February 5, 2027, and internationally beginning 3 February 2027, distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.
chineseContent: 她和他见过的任何人都不一样。由 M. Night Shyamalan 执导的《#RemainMovie》将于 2027 年情人节上映。由华纳兄弟影业出品的《Remain》由杰克·吉伦哈尔主演，是世界上两位最具创造力的人之间前所未有的合作：畅销书作家尼古拉斯·斯帕克斯 (Nicholas Sparks) 和富有远见的电影制片人 M. Night Shyamalan。当隐居建筑师泰特·戈登搬到沿海小镇完成他的最新项目时，他遇到了一位迷人的年轻女子，她把他从自己的外壳中拉了出来，进入了笼罩在小镇上空的致命谜团的中心。吉伦哈尔与菲比·戴内弗、阿什利·沃尔特斯、朱莉·哈格蒂和杰·O·桑德斯一起主演。沙马兰根据自己的剧本执导，故事由沙马兰和斯帕克斯编写。该片由沙马兰、阿什温·拉詹、马克·比恩斯托克和特里萨·帕克担任制片人，斯帕克斯担任执行制片人。与沙马兰一起幕后的还有摄影指导阿道夫·维罗索、制作设计师萨姆·利森科、剪辑师诺埃米·普莱斯韦克、服装设计师卡罗琳·邓肯、选角导演道格拉斯·艾贝尔、音乐总监加布·希尔弗和作曲家詹姆斯·牛顿·霍华德。华纳兄弟影业推出 Blinding Edge Pictures 制作的 M. Night Shyamalan 电影《Remain》，将于 2027 年 2 月 5 日在北美影院上映，并于 2027 年 2 月 3 日起在全球上映，由华纳兄弟影业发行。
